about: Memory budgets for npm run perf:memory (tools/perf/memory-check.mjs), part of npm run perf:check. A measure fails when it is over its max. measured: the value when the budget was set. Change a max only by editing this file, saying why in the commit (AGENTS.md, Budgets); `npm run perf:memory -- --suggest` prints this run's values with each kind's margin.

size.about: MB: max = measured x (1 + margin), at least measured + floor (three runs moved by 0.5% at most)

count.about: objects: max = measured x (1 + margin), at least measured + floor (three runs moved by 0.7% at most)

leakMB.about: growth over the rebuild cycles (MB): max = measured + absolute (three runs moved by 0.1 MB)

leakCount.about: growth over the rebuild cycles (objects): max = measured + absolute (one leaked a cycle fails)

mobile.counts.textures.why: +3 on 2026-11-06: the secret sites (ae38f28) are drawn by their own PropsView, three BatchedMeshes (a material each), and each BatchedMesh holds two small data textures (its matrices, 16x16 float, and its indirect index, 8x8): about 12 KB in all. Their geometry was trimmed (batches start small) instead.
